entries.title: Micah 2:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 Against oppression. 4 A lamentation. 7 A reproof of injustice and idolatry. 12 A promise of restoring Jacob.

Cir. A.M. 3274. B.C. 730. to. Es 3:8; 5:14; 9:25; Ps 7:14-16; 140:1-8; Pr 6:12-19; 12:2; Isa 32:7 Isa 59:3; Jer 18:18; Eze 11:2; Na 1:11; Lu 20:19; 22:2-6; Ac 23:12 Ro 1:30 work. Ps 36:4; Pr 4:16 when. Ho 7:6,7; Mt 27:1,2; Mr 15:1; Ac 23:15 because. Ge 31:29; De 28:32; Pr 3:27; Joh 19:11

entries.title: Micah 2:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: shall. Nu 23:7,18; 24:3,15; Job 27:1; Isa 14:4; Eze 16:44; Hab 2:6 Mr 12:12 and lament. 2Sa 1:17; 2Ch 35:25; Jer 9:10,17-21; 14:18; Joe 1:8,13; Am 5:1,17 a doleful lamentation. Heb. a lamentation of lamentations. La 1:1-5:22; Eze 2:10 We. De 28:29; Isa 6:11; 24:3; Jer 9:19; 25:9-11; Zep 1:2 he hath changed. 10; 1:15; 2Ki 17:23,24; 2Ch 36:20,21; Isa 63:17,18 turning away he. or, instead of restoring, he, etc.

entries.title: Micah 2:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: cast. De 32:8; Jos 18:4,10; Ps 16:6; Ho 9:3 the congregation. De 23:2,8; Ne 7:61

entries.title: Micah 2:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Prophesy ye, etc. or, Prophesy not as they prophesy. Heb.Drop. etc. Isa 30:10; Jer 26:8,9,20-23; Eze 20:46; 21:2; Am 2:12; 7:13 Ac 4:17; 5:28,40; 7:51; 1Th 2:15,16 they shall not prophesy. Ps 74:9; Eze 3:26; Am 8:11-13 that they. Jer 6:14,15; 8:11,12

entries.title: Micah 2:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: of late. Heb. yesterday. risen. 2Ch 28:5-8; Isa 9:21 with the garment. Heb. over against a garment. securely. 2Sa 20:19; 2Ch 28:8; Ps 55:20; 120:6,7

entries.title: Micah 2:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: women. or, wives. cast. 2; Mt 23:14; Mr 12:40; Lu 20:47 from their children. 1Sa 26:19; Joe 3:6 my glory. Ps 72:19; Eze 39:21; Hab 2:14; Zec 2:5; 2Co 3:18; 4:6
